title: Alpha - Feedback requested!
author: Tyvin31
selftext:
I'm an experienced software engineer, and I've been working on this part-time for a couple months - a MMO concept I dreamed up years ago, but would never have had the time to build without AI.

The idea is a pixel-art MMO, think old school Final Fantasy / Dragon Quest - but full player driven economy, even city building, in an infinite world.  It already includes exploration, harvesting, combat, initial skill, harvesting, and crafting systems, messaging, player founded cities and housing, and dungeons (caves and ruins).

I've been building my own world-editing tools as well, including sprite creation/animation, mob configuration, materials, drops - everything is configurable.

This is just a beta, there's a lot to go, but I'd love some feedback!  It's free, and player-characters are identified by browser tokens, not full-on logins yet.  This is a temporary server also, so it may not be up all that often.  You can try it out here: [http://beta.realmsreach.com](http://beta.realmsreach.com)

  
I'm going to turn it on for a while, and I'll be online, would love to see a few people check it out and give feedback!

Backlog items:

* Groups/Parties
* Melee skills (shield bash, stun, whirlwind, etc)
* Enchanting
* Many more skills and spells
* Town connections (players can built portals to warp to other tons)
* Town Taxes - players buy houses in cities that have upkeep, mayor can use this to upgrade the town, more buildings, defenses, NPCs
* Overworld Raids
* And much more!
